title: Pomodoro Web Timer
explanationWhat:
## What is Pomodoro Web Timer?

Pomodoro Web Timer is a productivity tool that helps you manage your work using the Pomodoro Technique.
explanationOrigin:
## Origin

The Pomodoro Technique was developed by Francesco Cirillo in the late 1980s. It encourages focused work sessions of 25 minutes, followed by short breaks, to improve concentration and productivity.
explanationHow:
## How to use it

1. Set your desired work interval.
2. Start the timer and focus on your task.
3. When the timer ends, take a short break.
4. Repeat the process and take longer breaks after several sessions.

You can customize the duration of your work and break intervals to fit your workflow.
